description: Codex hooks Vrooli depends on. `resource-codex ensure` (run by `vrooli setup`) and `resource-codex hooks apply` project them into $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json as identified entries; `hooks plan` shows what would change and whether Codex has been told to trust them. Codex does not run a hook until its owner trusts it in Codex (`/hooks`); trust is a human decision and is never written by Vrooli.

hooks.rationale: A sub-agent that names a model bypasses Agent Manager, so excluded_models in model-policy.json cannot stop it any other way. The hook denies (exit 2) only a call naming an excluded model; every error, a missing binary or a timeout lets the call run.
